# custom_tasks (Data Source)

Fetches the list of tasks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all tasks.
data "custom_tasks" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tasks` (Attributes List) List of tasks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Optional:

- `complete` (Boolean) Task completion status.
- `description` (String) Task description.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Date and time task was created.
- `id` (String) String uuid identifier of the task.
- `title` (String) Task title.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time task was last updated.
